mapper.sql: customer_contacts.id AS id, customer_contacts.customer_id AS leadId, customers.name AS leadName, customer_contacts.contact_name AS leadContactName, customer_contacts.sex AS gender, customer_contacts.contact_telephone AS contactTelephone, customer_contacts.contact_email AS contactEmail, customer_contacts.position AS position, customer_contacts.emp_personal_id AS personalizeIndexId, employee_personalities.name AS personalizeIndexName, customer_contacts.roles AS role, customer_contacts.work_flow AS workFlow, customer_contacts.needs AS needs, customer_contacts.wants AS wants, customer_contacts.pain_points AS painPoint, customer_contacts.note AS note, customer_contacts.created AS created, CONCAT(creator.first_name, ' ', creator.last_name) AS createdBy, customer_contacts.modified AS modified, CONCAT(modifier.first_name, ' ', modifier.last_name) AS modifiedBy

FROM customer_contacts LEFT JOIN customers ON customers.id = customer_contacts.customer_id LEFT JOIN employee_personalities ON employee_personalities.id = customer_contacts.emp_personal_id LEFT JOIN users AS creator ON creator.id = customer_contacts.created_by LEFT JOIN users AS modifier ON modifier.id = customer_contacts.modified_by
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO customer_contacts ( customer_id, contact_name, sex, contact_telephone, contact_email, position, emp_personal_id, roles, work_flow, needs, wants, pain_points, note, contact_type, is_active, created, created_by ) VALUES ( #{leadContact.leadId}, #{leadContact.contactName}, #{leadContact.gender}, #{leadContact.contactTelephone}, #{leadContact.contactEmail}, #{leadContact.position}, #{leadContact.personalizeIndexId}, #{leadContact.role}, #{leadContact.workFlow}, #{leadContact.needs}, #{leadContact.wants}, #{leadContact.painPoint}, #{leadContact.note}, 2, #{leadContact.isActive}, NOW(), #{leadContact.createdBy} )
mapper.update: UPDATE customer_contacts SET customer_id = #{leadContact.leadId}, contact_name = #{leadContact.contactName}, sex = #{leadContact.gender}, contact_telephone = #{leadContact.contactTelephone}, contact_email = #{leadContact.contactEmail}, position = #{leadContact.position}, emp_personal_id = #{leadContact.personalizeIndexId}, roles = #{leadContact.role}, work_flow = #{leadContact.workFlow}, needs = #{leadContact.needs}, wants = #{leadContact.wants}, pain_points = #{leadContact.painPoint}, note = #{leadContact.note}, contact_type = 2, is_active = 3, modified = NOW(), modified_by = #{leadContact.modifiedBy} WHERE id = #{leadContact.id} AND contact_type = 2
UPDATE customer_contacts SET is_active = 2, modified = NOW(), modified_by = #{userId} WHERE id = #{id} AND contact_type = 2 AND is_active = 3
